extName.message: True Mirror & Flip Image – The Face Analysis

extDesc.message: Online true mirror for your webcam: see the non-reversed view others see, check your light and flip any image. Nothing is uploaded.

popupCameraSub.message: Mirror or true view, light check, face guide

popupPhotoSub.message: See a picture the way others see you

privacy.message: Your camera picture and photos stay on this device. The extension uploads nothing and has no tracking.

notAdvice.message: Measurements on thefaceanalysis.com are proportions, not a medical or beauty verdict.

eyebrow.message: True mirror · light check · face guide

h1.message: Take a straight, well-lit photo of your face

lede.message: Switch between the mirror and how a camera really sees you, line your face up with the guide, fix the light, then save the photo to measure it.

camDenied.message: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera for this extension in the address bar or browser settings, then try again.

camMissing.message: No camera was found. Plug one in, or flip a photo instead.

camError.message: The camera could not start. Close other apps that use it, then try again.

badgeTrue.message: True view · how others see you

hintMirror.message: Flipped like a bathroom mirror — the face you are used to.

hintTrue.message: Not flipped — how other people and cameras see you.

photoWaiting.message: Add a photo to check its light.

lightGood.message: Good light — even and bright enough.

lightTooDark.message: Too dark. Face a window or a lamp.

lightDim.message: A little dim. Move closer to the light.

lightTooBright.message: Too bright — parts of the face are blown out. Soften or move away from the light.

lightShiny.message: Some shine on the skin. Diffuse the light or turn slightly.

lightUnevenLeft.message: Uneven: the left side of the picture is darker. Turn toward the light.

lightUnevenRight.message: Uneven: the right side of the picture is darker. Turn toward the light.

keys.message: Keys: Space freeze · S save · M mirror/true · G guide · L light ring

saved.message: Saved to your downloads. Now upload it to a measurement below.

savedFlipped.message: Flipped photo saved to your downloads.

notImage.message: That file is not an image.

dropBody.message: or click to choose one — you can also paste an image

photoPrivacy.message: The photo is opened on this device only.

measureBody.message: Open a free measurement on thefaceanalysis.com and upload the photo you saved. This extension does not upload anything.
